_comment: Trigger eval for config-auditor itself (used to measure the Trigger dimension and unlock the 10 that inspection caps at 9). 'trigger' = the auditor SHOULD fire: audit / review / score / harden / evaluate of EXISTING skills, agents, plugins, hooks, MCP, or settings. 'no-trigger' = HARD near-misses that share the same domain vocabulary (skill, plugin, hook, MCP, agent) but are authoring / explaining / using / lifecycle / debugging-ops, NOT auditing. Labels are kept unambiguous on purpose — the discriminating power is in the no-trigger set. Run from an authenticated terminal (claude -p must work); this makes real model calls and costs tokens.
